name: 劉傳銘
objective:
本課程主要介紹在計算機科學中常見或基本的資料結構, 探討的主題包括: ADT (抽像資料型態) 及複雜度, 靜態結構與儲存表示, 陣列，堆疊，佇列，串列，樹狀結構，遞迴，排序，搜尋。
This course give the fundamental concpets and topics about data structures in computer science. The topics incluce ADT (Abstract Data Type), complexity, static structures, arrays ,stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, recursion, sorting, searching, as well as graphs.
課程進度(1-16週):
1. Python Basis (3hrs)
2. Introduction and Recursion (3hrs)
3. Analysis Tools (4hrs)
4. Arrays, Stacks, and Queues (3hrs)
5. Linked Lists (3hrs)
6. Trees (5hrs)
MIDTERM EXAM (3hrs, review session included)
7. Priority Queues (3hrs)
8. Maps and Dictionaries (3hrs)
9. Search Trees (9hrs)
10. Graphs (6hrs)
FINAL EXAM (3hrs, review session included)
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Quick implementation on some advanced data structures, such as R-trees, Quad-trees, Trie, … etc. with groups of 2-3 students. This implementation can use AI tools as references.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Each group should turn in the resulting project with a document showing how to execute and use the implemented package.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          This part will be a reference about the assessment, not a requirement.
